summary: Full end-to-end test of SyncSite Noticias (Activities) feature. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed (auth, areas, reports regression, /api/activities CRUD with role-based filtering & permissions, /api/ai/period-summary daily/weekly/monthly with area filter, daily-summary regression). Frontend: Both Coordinador and Especialista land on /(role)/noticias after login; Noticias is the FIRST/initial tab in the bottom Tab Bar for both roles. Día/Semana/Mes period tabs work; Generar resumen IA calls /api/ai/period-summary and returns a Gemini-generated executive summary (validated text content). Activities are visually grouped by priority with colored section headers (Urgente=red, Importante=amber, Informativo=blue) + colored left border + tinted background + colored badge. FAB opens create modal with priority chips N1/N2/N3 and (coordinador only) area selector including Global. Especialista does NOT see Global chip and shows 'Esta noticia se publicará en tu área' hint. Specialist visibility correctly enforced: Geotecnia esp sees own area + global activities only; does NOT see Topografía-only activities. Delete button visible for creator/coordinador only. AI summary content is coherent and references actual reports. No regressions observed in login/report/areas flows. Minor warnings detected (see issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[Layout children]: Too many screens defined. Route "camera" is extraneous.' Stack.Screen name="camera" is declared in app/_layout.tsx:37 but there is no app/camera.tsx file. Either remove the Stack.Screen entry or create the camera screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:37

Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from the theme shadow tokens and from a Pressable/Button. Non-blocking but should migrate before SDK upgrade. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow tokens)

action_items: Remove the orphan Stack.Screen entry name="camera" in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:37 (or create app/camera.tsx) to silence the 'extraneous route' warning.
Migrate shadow.* style tokens to boxShadow and any props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (non-blocking, deprecation warnings only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:454-456 — list_activities does two consecutive .sort() calls; the first one (priority desc, createdAt) is immediately overridden by the second pure-priority sort. The current behaviour still works because Python's sort is stable and cursor already returns docs by createdAt desc, but the redundant first sort is dead code and confusing. Consider single sort: out.sort(key=lambda x: (-x.priority, x.createdAt), reverse=False) is wrong too; use out.sort(key=lambda x: x.createdAt, reverse=True) then out.sort(key=lambda x: x.priority, reverse=True).
NoticiasScreen.tsx is ~800 lines; consider splitting CreateActivityModal, ActivityCard, PrioritySectionHeader into separate files for maintainability (file size guideline >700 lines).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded users/areas. Test activities are auto-cleaned by pytest fixture (delete via coordinador). A couple of UI-created activities (TEST_UI_Noticia, TEST_Solo_Topografia) remain in DB — main agent can ignore or delete via UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_noticias.py and can be re-run with: cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL python -m pytest tests/test_noticias.py -v. Frontend confirmed working on mobile viewport 390x844. The 'camera' route warning is a separate (pre-existing) layout bug unrelated to Noticias feature.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found in the Noticias feature. The 'extraneous camera route' warning RCA: app/_layout.tsx declares Stack.Screen for a 'camera' route but the corresponding file was not created (or was removed without cleaning the layout).
